purpose: Test whether local correct-versus-impostor prototype margins identify nonlinear signal that a class-mean diagonal metric cannot see.

prototype_margin_metric.internal_split: deterministic stratified 50/50 split; first half fits provisional prototypes and disjoint second half estimates margins
prototype_margin_metric.provisional_backend: MiniBatchKMeans with four prototypes per class, n_init=1, init=random
prototype_margin_metric.correct_prototype: nearest provisional prototype owned by the row label under raw Euclidean distance
prototype_margin_metric.impostor_prototype: nearest provisional prototype owned by another label under raw Euclidean distance
prototype_margin_metric.feature_margin: mean[(x-impostor)^2-(x-correct)^2] on the disjoint margin half
prototype_margin_metric.final_fit: refit current OI once on all selector training rows in the learned diagonal metric
prototype_margin_metric.heldout: apply the frozen metric and score_fixed without refitting

interpretation.success_signal: Prototype metric improves nonlinear-nuisance rank/regret over both raw and class-mean diagonal OI without losing linear-nuisance performance.
interpretation.runtime_claim: Toy only; runtime includes the extra provisional prototype fit.
